answer_1.quote: In recent years, large language models (LLM) have demonstrated extraordinary general capabilities, and are widely used for question-answering, code generation, mathematics, and other fields.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to questions in multiple-choice and free-form formats, performs mathematical reasoning, and follows instructions in downstream tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the proposed SLIM on the OpenChat-8B model ... The fine-tuned models under MDS are evaluated on the general tasks including MMLU , GSM8K , and PIQA  to measure the catastrophic forgetting of the PEFT approaches.
